scope: Static package, producer/consumer, exact-archive, profile-command and input-mount review only. No GPU execution, fit, provider call, queue action or admission change was performed.

static_validator.command: python validate_profile_r3.py under scripts/limited (25% CPU, 700000000-byte memory cap, 120-second command cap)

archive_members.method: Independently opened final bundle.wnn as gzip tar and streamed each member SHA-256 and byte count.

profile_command.comparison: R3 argv equals frozen R1 argv after only the source-entrypoint path and run name are updated and --grad-stats is added.

source_delta: opt-in progress/time events around the unchanged full-content SHA-256 path
opt-in split-load begin/source-count/end events; membership checks retained
profile-only actual optimizer/update counters before the existing early return
resource_and_diagnostic_delta.gradient_diagnostics: GradStats observes existing unscaled gradients before clipping and does not modify them; its compute/synchronization overhead is disclosed and makes timing nonrepresentative of a full fit.

payload_entrypoint_and_mounts.entrypoint_chain: kernel.py verifies the fixed archive hash, extracts declared files, invokes the archived kaggle_gpu_runner.py with exactly one spec; runner sets PYTHONPATH to experiment/src; cleanfold_exec.py confines the child script to the frozen source snapshot and launches scripts/train_rnn.py.

non_blocking_documentation_qualification.finding: README_R3 describes 5 warmup and 25 measured 'updates', but train_rnn.py sets max_batches = profile_warmup + profile_steps and StageTimer closes once per complete batch; optimizer attempts occur inside the per-batch chunk loop.
non_blocking_documentation_qualification.recommendation: Describe these as 5 warmup batches plus 25 measured batches. Use PROFILE_UPDATE_COUNTS for actual optimizer attempts, AMP skips and completed updates. Keep the warning that --grad-stats adds diagnostic overhead.
non_blocking_documentation_qualification.release_impact: The runnable profile remains valid; do not report 25 as the optimizer-update count or interpret its diagnostic timing as full-fit throughput.

limitations: No profile was run by this reviewer, and no full fit is authorized by this receipt.
The packet does not establish checkpoint save/reload correctness, export time, two-device concurrency, cohort memory, or full-fit ETA.
The observed startup-hash diagnosis remains a plausible explanation, not a proven historical stalled frame.
